cases.name: Software patent invalidated by a 2018 arXiv paper

verdict.consensus_reasoning: Voided: challenge 1 invalidated the patent first.

citations_matched: "BERT is designed to pre-train deep bidirectional representations from unlabeled text by jointly conditioning on both left and right context in all layers."
"We introduce a new language representation model called BERT... Bidirectional Encoder Representations from Transformers."
"the pre-trained BERT model can be fine-tuned with just one additional output layer to create ... models for ... question answering and language inference"
verdict.consensus_reasoning: The source expressly discloses each claim element in the same arrangement: pre-training a deep bidirectional transformer from unlabeled text using both left and right context in all layers, then fine-tuning with one added output layer for question answering or language inference. As a BERT paper, it is enabling for skilled practitioners.

cases.name: Hardware architecture: cited prior art post-dates priority, bond slashed

citations_matched: "accelerates the inference phase of neural networks (NN)"
"The heart of the TPU is a 65,536 8-bit MAC matrix multiply unit"
verdict.consensus_reasoning: The source clearly discloses NN inference, a matrix multiply unit, 8-bit MACs, and large on-chip memory. However, the provided text does not disclose the claimed systolic array arrangement, a unified buffer holding input activations, a weight FIFO staging weights, or accumulators collecting array output. It therefore does not disclose every claim element as arranged, and the excerpt lacks sufficient technical detail for enablement of the full claimed combination.
Source unreachable or returned no readable content.
